title: Day of Horse
wikitext:
Draft team. In Polish "day of horse" means actually both - a day when everything goes right and a day when everything goes wrong. Most possible etymology of that term comes from the uhlans military times, when the day when horses were resting was good for animals but not good for soldiers who cannot use them.
